item.title: 14th Annual Wine Country Yarn Hop — Sun Jul 19, 10:00 AM — Cast Away Yarn Shop
item.description:
Join us for the 14th annual Northern California yarn lovers experience from July 17-19, 2026! The Wine Country Yarn Hop consists of 5 shops located in the beautiful Wine Country between Petaluma & Ukiah. The 2026 Yarn Hop is FREE and begins July 17, 2026 at 10:00am. The Hop is 3 days long, you can choose to do all 5 shops in one day, or spread it out and hop all weekend. All 5 shops are open from 10:00 – 5:00 each day of the Hop: July 17, 18 & 19. You will receive a passport to be stamped at each shop, as well as 1 raffle ticket per stop. Participants will be entered to win a prize basket at each shop, AND the Grand Prize basket when a complete passport is turned in. FREE patterns, and free enamel pins w/ tote or lanyard purchase. No need to register – just start hopping at any of the 5 shops! Learn more: winecountryyarnhop.com Fiber Circle Studios- Petaluma Noma Knits- Sonoma Cast Away Yarn Shop- Santa Rosa Purls of Joy- Healdsburg Purple Needle- Ukiah
Source: GoLocal Cooperat
